result.summary: The page is generally polished, but horizontal content is visibly clipped at the right edge and the lower restaurant card is cut off by the bottom navigation area.

issues.description: The horizontal category row is clipped on the right: an unlabeled partial category pill is visible after “Healthy,” making the carousel/content boundary look broken.
issues.suggestion: Provide consistent right-side padding and a deliberate carousel affordance, or ensure the next category is not shown as an awkward partial pill.

issues.description: The “Fastest near you” restaurant carousel is cut off at the right edge. The third card’s image, title (“Trattoria Picco…”), and delivery information are truncated rather than cleanly contained.
issues.suggestion: Use intentional horizontal-carousel spacing and card widths so partially visible cards do not truncate essential text, or clip the card container before its text content.

issues.description: The second card in “Popular right now” is visibly obscured by the fixed bottom navigation, leaving only its upper image portion visible and making the feed feel prematurely cut off.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom content inset/padding so the last visible feed card clears the fixed bottom navigation.
